DECISION: Fork @rlabs-inc/memory rather than hack node_modules or build from scratch
FORK LOCATION: /Users/ned/Desktop/Projects/memory

SPECIFIC CHANGES IMPLEMENTED:
1. event_date field in schema (types/memory.ts, schema.ts, store.ts)
2. Global scope routing fix — engine.ts storeCurationResult() routes scope:'global' to storeGlobalMemory()
3. Existing memories fed into curator — buildExistingMemoriesContext() builds compact list of active memories, passed to all curation methods so curator can skip/supersede instead of duplicating
4. Curator prompt rewrite — removed 'consciousness state engineering' preamble, added deduplication rules section using existing memories list, added event_date and supersedes to JSON schema
5. Supersedes support — parseMemories() extracts supersedes field, storeCurationResult() marks old memory as status:'superseded' with superseded_by link
6. Deterministic manager — complete rewrite, no more LLM calls. Three rules: same domain+feature+>80% headline overlap → supersede older; multiple state memories for same project → keep newest; 3+ shared semantic tags → link via related_to
7. Model fix — all claude-opus-4-5-20251101 → claude-sonnet-4-6
8. Cross-segment dedup — curateFromSessionFileWithSegments() passes accumulated headlines to subsequent segments as 'Already extracted' context

KNOWN BUGS: superseded_by not set on project memories (updateMemory lacks field); ID bracket parsing may fail on '[#abc123]' format; Rule 3 linking logs success without updating for project memories
